definition.gBlockFront: m; inner front tyre outer edge to the road-side start of the red/white block band, minimum over the pass (negative = on the blocks)
definition.gBlockRear: m; same for the inner rear tyre
definition.gPaintFront: m; inner front tyre outer edge to the road-side start of the kerb paint (white strip = track-limit line)
definition.gPaintRear: m; same for the inner rear tyre
definition.apexStation: m; CG road station where gBlockFront is minimal (clipping point)
definition.apexT: s; recorded lap t (GPS time base of the shipped lap JSON, playback clock) at the clipping point
definition.apexLapTime: s; apexT + meta.first_sample_after_lap_start_seconds (time since the timing line, as the HUD lap clock)
definition.onBlockLengthM: m; path length of the inner front tyre while gBlockFront < 0
definition.exitOuterGapM: m; outer tyres vs the opposite road edge (paint start at kerbs), -10 m to +120 m from the kerb end (negative = beyond)
definition.contact: IMU label of this pass from kerb_contacts.json (class strong/silent/mild, strength bin low/mid/high = 弱/中/強); no left/right attribution
definition.labelCheck: IMU label vs geometry: strong-but-off = strong label with min(gBlockFront, gBlockRear) > 0.15 m; silent-but-deep = silent label with it < -0.55 m (a GPS/course disagreement, not a verdict); ok; null for mild
definition.deltaVsSessionMedian: value minus the median of the same corner over the distributed laps of this session (primary comparison: a common GPS bias cancels)
definition.pass: samples whose CG station lies within the kerb station range +-3 m; a gap counts only where the tyre projects onto the kerb line between its end vertices
definition.wheelPaths: 50 Hz cubic spline of the registered GPS track; heading from the spline derivative; tyre outer edges at +-(track + tyre width)/2, axles at +-wheelbase/2 from the antenna (assumed at the vehicle centre)

absoluteUncertaintyReason: The shipped registration is a road-limit fit: inside the road its cost is flat over 0.5-1 m, and the IMU kerb-contact labels bound the remaining lateral GPS error only to about +-0.4-0.7 m (docs/fuji-apex-kerb-kpi-2026-10-02.md). Kerb lines come from the 2019 orthophoto (georeferencing ~0.2-0.3 m, not verified against 2020). Compare laps at the same corner (delta) first.
deltaCaveat: Each lap has its own registration offset; a lap-specific GPS error (e.g. 7/30 L2 at 3250-3600 m) is not cancelled by the delta.

registration.note: SHIPPED track-limit registration; the opt-in kerb-contact candidate is not used here
